settings.hero_subheadline: Early adopters share how MOOV changed the first hour of their day.

settings.quote: I've tried every morning hack out there. MOOV is the first thing that actually made me get out of bed without negotiating with myself. Standing to silence it changes everything.
The app blocking feature alone is worth it. I used to check Instagram before my feet hit the floor. Now I make coffee first. Small thing, massive difference.
The routines adapt to how much time I have. Some mornings it's 10 minutes, some it's 45. MOOV figures it out. I don't have to think about it.
I was skeptical. Now I'm the person telling everyone about it. Three weeks in and I haven't snoozed once. My partner pre-ordered one after watching me.
Love how it doesn't feel like a productivity gimmick. It's calm and simple. Wake up, stand up, do your thing. No gamification, no streaks guilt.
My first hour used to disappear into my phone. Now it belongs to me. MOOV made that switch easier than any amount of willpower ever did.
